maintenance_led.reason: Sells new vaccines, antitoxins and NARCAN nasal spray as first-time product purchases, not repair or servicing of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Biodefense products (CYFENDUS, BioThrax, antitoxins) are mostly sold to US government stockpiles; NARCAN also goes to public agencies.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows through its own government contracts and products like NARCAN and CYFENDUS; only occasional acquisitions of sites and rights.

mission_critical.reason: FDA-licensed countermeasures like anthrax vaccine and botulism antitoxin are specialized stockpile products; switching needs regulatory approval and re-contracting.

notes: Government share of revenue comes from my knowledge of the company; the website text only implies it.
